context:
Goal: measure the open Duo fold, as you chose in item 14.
Problem: at 12:28 CDT the run asked macOS for Device Hub access and got "denied". You were likely away from the Mac, or macOS remembered the 01:26 denial. Only you can click Allow on that prompt.
Meanwhile: Duo draws design round 2 with both keyboard cases, so nothing waits on this.
ref: item 14 duo-fold-measure (you picked a: let it drive Device Hub once)
steps: Mark this done when you are at the Mac and free for about a minute.
When the macOS prompt asks to let Claude control Device Hub, click Allow.
If no prompt appears, open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility and check whether Claude is listed as denied.
title: Be at the Mac to click Allow for the one Duo fold measurement
